verified_facts.text: The WET Pool is an outdoor pool with views of the South China Sea, for swimming day or night.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cool off day or night in WET Pool, our 1,338 square meter outdoor pool with views of the sparkling South China Sea.

verified_facts.text: Some suites have private plunge pools with views of the WET pool, the marina and the South China Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dip your toes in your own private plunge pool while soaking up breathtaking panoramic views of WET pool, the marina, and the South China Sea.

verified_facts.text: AWAY Spa has a rainforest design and facilities including a decompression lounge, infrared therapy, a steam room, a whirlpool and a vitality pool.

verified_facts.text: The lobby has columns that bloom up like mushrooms, and the entrance has glass installations.

verified_facts.text: The WET Deck pool has a slide.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is set along the marina waterfront.
The hotel is near Sentosa's beaches and moments from the island's attractions.

verified_facts.text: The Whatever/Whenever service can arrange scuba diving, sailing trips and island hopping.
